name: Webifysys Quantity and Pricing Tiers for WooCommerce
author: webifysys

sections.description:
Webifysys Quantity and Pricing Tiers for WooCommerce is the solution for controlling product quantities in your WooCommerce store. Set minimum and maximum purchase limits, enforce step increments, create dynamic pricing tiers, and track customer behavior with built-in analytics.

🚀 Key Features

Quantity Rules
* Define step/increment values (e.g., buy in multiples of 6, 12, 24)
* Create category-level rules for product groups
* Support for simple, variable, and grouped products

Cart-Level Controls
* Enforce minimum/maximum cart quantity (total items)
* Set minimum/maximum cart total (monetary value)
* Option to include or exclude taxes in calculations
* Block checkout when rules are violated

Pricing Tiers (Bulk Discounts)
* Create quantity-based pricing tiers (e.g., 10-49 units: 10% off, 50+: 20% off)
* Support for percentage or fixed discounts
* Display pricing tables on product pages
* Automatic price calculation in cart
* Works with variable products and variations

Custom Quantity Selectors
* 4 modern quantity selector styles: Default, Plus/Minus, Dropdown, Buttons
* Mobile-responsive designs
* Automatic min/max/step enforcement

Analytics & Reporting
* Track violation statistics by product and type
* View top products with violations
* Analyze violation trends over time
* Automatic data retention management
* Export-ready data for further analysis

Notifications & Alerts
* Email notifications when violation thresholds are reached
* Webhook integration for external systems
* High-value order alerts when expensive carts are blocked
* Configurable notification thresholds

User Role Restrictions
* Apply different rules based on user roles
* Guest user restrictions
* Member-only quantity limits

Enhanced User Experience
* Customizable error messages with template variables
* Helpful suggestions (e.g., “Add 3 more to meet minimum”)
* Visual limit indicators on product pages
* Real-time validation on product and cart pages
* Translation-ready with .pot file included

Developer-Friendly
* Clean, well-documented code
* HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatible
* Follows WordPress and WooCommerce coding standards

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect or transmit any personal data outside your WordPress installation. All analytics data is stored locally in your database.

If you enable webhook notifications, violation data will be sent to the configured webhook URL. You are responsible for ensuring compliance with privacy regulations.

sections.installation:
Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/webifysys-quantity-pricing-tiers-woocommerce/
  3. Activate through the Plugins menu in WordPress

Configuration

  1. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Flexible Quantity and Price Rules
  2. Configure your global settings in the General Settings section
  3. Set up category rules, pricing tiers, and exclusions as needed
  4. Optionally enable analytics and notifications in Advanced Settings
sections.faq:
Can I set different rules for different products?

Yes! You can set unique rules on individual products or variations. Go to the product edit page and scroll to the “Min/Max Quantity Rules” section.

Does this work with variable products?

Absolutely. You can set rules for the parent product (applies to all variations) or set unique rules for each individual variation.

Can I create bulk pricing discounts?

Yes! Use the Pricing Tiers section to create quantity-based discounts. For example: 1-9 units at regular price, 10-49 units at 10% off, 50+ units at 20% off.

What happens when a customer violates a rule?

The plugin displays a user-friendly error message explaining the issue and prevents checkout. You can customize these messages in the Advanced Settings.

Can I exclude certain products from rules?

Yes. Use the Rules Exclusion section to exclude specific products or entire categories from min, max, step, or all rules.

Does this plugin track analytics?

Yes! The built-in analytics dashboard tracks violation statistics, top products with violations, and trends over time. You can also receive email or webhook notifications.

Is this compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Can I customize the quantity selector design?

Yes! Choose from 4 modern quantity selector styles to match your theme.

Will this slow down my site?

No. The plugin is optimized for performance with efficient database queries and minimal frontend JavaScript.
